appearance_facts.fact: The red dashed line (High fibre) is at the chart's top edge, while the blue solid line (Other) is near the bottom edge.
The blue line has a bold numeric label '18' positioned directly above its data point.
The red line has no visible numeric label at this position.
The red line drops to a low point labeled '6', while the blue line rises to a point labeled '20'.

public_definitions: Use the displayed comparison for the 11-18 years age group to determine which cereal category should be escalated for adolescent fibre-support follow-up, or whether it should be sent for general reference review.
uncertain: The specific numerical value for the red line (High fibre) at the 11-18 years mark is not explicitly labeled, though it is visually the highest point on the chart.
